setup.command: cd backend && (test -d venv || python3 -m venv venv) && (grep -v -i pyside6 requirements.txt > /tmp/nf-requirements.txt) && ./venv/bin/pip install -q -r /tmp/nf-requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt && cd ../frontend && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

run.command: cd backend && (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen AUTHND_TOKEN_MODE=pool ./venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 54321 &) && cd ../frontend && npm run dev:web -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
